issues.location: MUTATION-PROBES.md:268 (§7, WP-C) and RESIDUAL-RISKS.md:1191 (RES-60 What): "Of the runs on record, only WP-B's targeted tests kill C, F and S"
issues.problem: This is the ruling's exact wording, so it is not blocking. But "of the runs on record" now covers every recorded run, and the writer's check (results-c2.txt, mut/) missed one: the crash hunter's `.build-orchestrator/s3-probes/crash/S3-CRAS-05-mutants-run.txt` ran C, F and S against 98-99 targeted tests. So the writer's report is wrong where it says no other recorded run kills them. In that run, F (:74-77, :116-119) and S (:109-113) fail only cases in StoreDeletionTests and LeaseTests. C (:63-67) also fails `EvictionTests.swift`'s "R-SYN-11: eviction frees space while every index commit fails with ENOSPC" (:67), and that file is not one of the three that s3c.md:494-495 calls WP-B's targeted tests. "WP-B's" is the records' own loose label: DECISIONS.md:622 says the same "only", and the LeaseTests and EvictionTests cases both came in WP-C's Stage 2 merge 38d23f9. The substance still holds: only targeted unit tests kill C, F and S, never WP-C's oracle or flows (S3-CRAS-02-run.txt:20-25).
issues.fix: Orchestrator's call. Either keep it as ruled, or add in both places: "; in the crash hunter's run C also fails EvictionTests' R-SYN-11 case (`.build-orchestrator/s3-probes/crash/S3-CRAS-05-mutants-run.txt:63-67`)".
